notes: Parabasalid flagellate (Metamonada); T. muris and T. angusta figured. The GBIF backbone holds Trichomonas only as a doubtful, unplaced genus under Animalia (key 8265662, no authorship, no species), which is nevertheless the usage its 'Trichomonas' occurrence records are indexed under, so that key is recorded; the lineage given here is the modern placement (NCBI Taxonomy), not GBIF's. GBIF backbone marks this name DOUBTFUL. Treated as an animal by Thompson; not Metazoa in modern taxonomy (see lineage).
